title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet
before: Reasoning models were a separate product line from chat models.
problem: Users had to pick the right model, and reasoning cost applied even to trivial questions.
breakthrough: One model with an extended thinking mode you can switch on, and a visible budget for how long it thinks.
why: The hybrid design became the industry pattern, ending the split between chat and reasoning models.
next: GPT-5's router and Gemini 2.5's thinking models followed the same logic.
inherits: Reasoning as a dial on a single model.
